events.title: OPEC+ boosts September production by 188,000 barrels/day
events.description: Saudi Arabia, Russia and five other key members of OPEC+ agreed to boost oil production by 188,000 barrels a day from September.

events.title: Trump cancels Iran attack
events.description: US President Donald Trump announced that he will cancel a pending attack on Iran after a rough framework of a peace deal had been reached.

events.title: Israel kills several in Gaza

events.title: Shooting in Idaho

events.title: US and Japan intervene to lift yen

events.title: Three people killed in shooting at In-N-Out Burger in Idaho

events.title: France makes major progress in wildfire fight, but danger still lurks
events.description: Even though France's biggest wildfire crisis since 1949 has been contained, many of the blazes are still burning.

events.title: State Department urges Americans to consider leaving Middle East as regional conflict escalates

events.title: Gaza officials say Israeli strikes kill seven

events.title: EU to Hold Urgent Meeting of Interior Ministers on Tuesday Over Ceuta Crisis

events.title: Nirmal Purja, nine others, die in avalanche in Pakistan
events.description: Celebrated Nepali climber Nirmal Purja, who set a record for the fastest ascent of the world's 14 highest mountains, died in an avalanche during an expedition in Pakistan.
